objective: Preallocate ANALYZE table statistics keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate table stats keys
tasks.result: ANALYZE statistics load/store paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for stats:table:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for stats:table:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in load_table_stats() and store_table_stats().
Generated stats key bytes, ANALYZE statistics storage, EXPLAIN statistics consumption, and DDL behavior are unchanged.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/analyze.rs while exiting successfully.
